name: SAVIOR
source:
In the future, scientists mastered the technique of cloning, succeeding in creating fully functional artificial life forms. However, a powerful corporation took control over creation of such beings, using them for their own purposes. One of those artificial humans, a girl named Emma, managed to escape, holding some important information that supposedly incriminates the corporation. You control another artificial girl, Nel. You were just created, and the assignment you receive from your boss Elena is to find where Emma is hiding, and to prevent her from leaving the corporation building.

Savior is a Japanese-style adventure game, without puzzles or action elements. However, unlike most other hentai titles, you can freely move in a 3D environment, viewing it from third- or first-person perspective. You navigate Nel through the game world, exploring it and searching for clues. Important events are displayed either as still CG images or pre-rendered movies. Many of these images and movies contain explicit sexual content. You can view them again from a special menu accessible from the title screen.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/windows/savior]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
未来，科学家掌握了克隆技术，成功创造出机能完备的人造生命体。然而，一家势力庞大的企业控制了这类生命的制造，并利用它们实现自己的目的。人造人少女Emma成功逃脱，还掌握着据说足以证明该企业罪行的重要信息。玩家控制的是另一名人造少女Nel。你才刚刚诞生，上司Elena便交给你一项任务：找出Emma的藏身之处，阻止她离开企业大楼。

《Savior》是一款不含谜题或动作要素的日式冒险游戏。不过，与大多数同类成人游戏不同，玩家可以在3D环境中自由移动，并选择第三人称或第一人称视角。你需要操控Nel探索游戏世界，搜寻线索。重要事件会以静态CG或预渲染影片呈现，其中许多图像和影片包含露骨成人内容，并可通过标题画面的专用菜单再次观看。

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/windows/savior]Moby Games[/url]]
